subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the sole protected-environment deployment authority for crawl-remote production under this coordinated cutover?
rationale: Code inspection supports the defensive implementation, but only repository operators can approve the permanent authority transfer, configure the protected environment, validate token scope and reviewer policy, and accept the forward-migration rollback contract.

options.title: Approve supervised cutover
options.body: Merge this workflow while it remains fail-closed, coordinate https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37, provision the protected environment, and run a supervised dormant rollout before enabling active states.

options.title: Retain service-owned deployment
options.body: Do not activate this path and keep production mutation in crawl-remote until maintainers approve a different authority or rollback model.

recommendation.title: Approve supervised cutover
recommendation.body: Merge this workflow while it remains fail-closed, coordinate https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37, provision the protected environment, and run a supervised dormant rollout before enabling active states.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository history shows the broadest ownership of ClawSweeper workflows and deployment-adjacent automation, making him the strongest available owner for this repository-level security decision.
